dict.string: Kobi lowers other apps' audio while it talks. It never records or saves that audio.
Kobi talks to Claude Code sessions in your project folders. It needs access when a project is on the Desktop.
Kobi talks to Claude Code sessions in your project folders. It needs access when a project is in Documents.
Kobi talks to Claude Code sessions in your project folders. It needs access when a project is in Downloads.
Kobi listens for "Hey Kobi" and for commands while you hold the hotkey. Audio stays on this Mac and is never saved.
Kobi talks to Claude Code sessions in your project folders. It needs access when a project is on a network drive.
Kobi talks to Claude Code sessions in your project folders. It needs access when a project is on an external drive.
Kobi hears your voice commands a second way with Apple's on-device speech recognition. Nothing leaves your Mac.
